# Shreyansh Singh

Official website: https://shreyanshsingh.in/

Shreyansh Singh is an Indian founder and technologist working across artificial intelligence, clean energy, defence technology, industrial systems and enterprise software.

## Current ventures and areas of work

- Sthapana Technologies Pvt Ltd: AI, enterprise software and defence-technology development.
- Cloud Energy: renewable-energy capacity reservation, battery energy storage and energy-management infrastructure.
- WapVenture Technologies Pvt Ltd: digital and enterprise technology solutions.
- FinAI: agentic finance operating system for financial intelligence and controllership.
- Defence navigation: celestially referenced, integrity-bounded navigation for defence and autonomous platforms.
